name: paper-collage-reveal
description: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

vars.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.
Color per scrap. Mixed seeds a different tone per scrap for a real scrapbook mix.
Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.
